rv.q: This is cutting-edge Chicago-style ensemble theatre flourishing in a new and reimagined medium—a compelling non-stop, live-staged performance...
This thoroughly engaging, timely, and provocative piece of theatre isn't the last word on what we've been through, but it is the perfect statement of how we are feeling about it right now.
It’s a fine viral production from one of Chicago’s premiere theatre companies.
Some may see this show as being a call-to-arms, but others, like myself, will find it unsatisfying.

cn.t: Holter's pandemic-era snapshot earns mostly strong praise for its ambitious, introspective examination of 2020's upheaval, though one critic finds it falls short compared to similar works.
